items.title: Unified Voice, SMS, and WhatsApp on Amazon Connect Customer
items.summary: Building a unified multi-channel agent experience Building a unified agent workspace for voice, SMS, and WhatsApp requires connecting three distinct communication channels — each with its own provisioning path, compliance model, and throughput characteristics — into a single routing and analytics experience.
